summary: Package consists of an HTML loader that fetches and executes remote code from a Cloudflare Worker
details: The entire package is a single HTML file (also declared as `main`) that, when opened or served, fetches HTML/JavaScript from https://loader.p2pgames.workers.dev/ and injects it into the document via `document.write`. The remote endpoint is mutable and author-controlled, with no version pinning, subresource integrity, or content scoping — whoever uses the package executes whatever the Worker currently serves at the moment of load. The fetch does not fire on `npm install` or `require()`; it fires only when a consumer opens or serves index.html, which is the package's advertised purpose. Because the harmful code path requires a separate user action (loading the HTML in a browser) rather than auto-executing on default install, this routes to human review rather than auto-block. The remote-loader shape is structurally unsafe regardless: the served bytes can change at any time without republishing the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
